units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale recorded

camera.view: top-down (whale seen from above/dorsal side), orthographic-looking, plain grey backdrop with radial vignette; no ground markings
camera.evidence: background vignette identical in all frames; blowhole y constant to +-0.1 px

objects.name: whale
objects.description: grey humpback-like whale seen from above, head pointing left (-x), long pectoral fins up and down, tail fluke at right. Only object in the scene.
objects.reference_point: blowhole_x/blowhole_y = template-tracked body-fixed blowhole marking on the head (best proxy for the rig origin's motion; the body translates rigidly). cx_mask/cy_mask = mask centroid (noisier, shadow-affected in frames with edge_closed=0). bbox_cx/bbox_cy = centre of the silhouette bbox (moves with tail and fin flapping).

motion.direction: -x (leftward), purely horizontal in image; y of blowhole constant at 765.0 +-0.1 px
motion.frames_0_1_identical: no motion between frame 0 and frame 1 (blowhole 1055.00 -> 1054.98)

length_snout_to_fluke_tip.note: varies with the up/down tail beat (fluke foreshortened from above)

span_y_fin_tip_to_fin_tip.note: pectoral fins flap; this is the image-y extent (width across the body axis)

static_objects.name: backdrop
static_objects.description: uniform light-grey background with dark vignette at corners, no features

events.event: steady leftward swimming starts (first displacement frame 1->2)
tail/fin beat: length minimum (fluke most foreshortened)
